answer: WNT2+ and PEAR1+ prenatal fibroblasts express genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (IL1R1), and collagen deposition (POSTN). PEAR1+ fibroblasts additionally express pro-inflammatory genes APOE, IGFBP7, and ITM2A.
support_quote: Notably, WNT2 + and PEAR1 + prenatal fibroblasts expressed several genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (for example, IL1R1) and collagen deposition (for example, POSTN)
